proposals.before: In Qianfu year 3 Li Guochang's son Keyong, of the Datong Army command, was Yunzhong defense commissioner; he slew the defense envoy, seized the prefecture, and sent word to court.
proposals.after: In Qianfu year 3 Li Guochang, Datong Army military commissioner, had a son Keyong who served as Yunzhong defense commissioner; Keyong slew the defense envoy, seized the prefecture, and sent word to court.
proposals.reason: Chinese makes 大同軍節度使 modify 李國昌, with son 克用 holding 雲中守捉使; idiomatic English wrongly attaches the Datong Army command to Keyong.

proposals.before: In the first year of Yongchun Mochuo's raids harried the people, and the populace was relocated to Shuo.
proposals.after: In the first year of Yongchun, Mochuo's raids harried the people, and the populace was relocated to Shuo.
proposals.reason: Insert a comma after Yongchun so the reign year is not fused with the personal name Mochuo.

proposals.before: Early Guangming forces defeated Guochang; with the Dai north undefended, Taizu attacked, took it, and carried off the populace.
proposals.after: Early in Guangming, Guochang was defeated; with the Dai north undefended, Taizu attacked, took it, and carried off the populace.
proposals.reason: Chinese 攻敗國昌 does not name the attackers; English 'forces defeated Guochang' invents an agent. Prefer passive.

proposals.before: It stood one hundred ten li north of Eastern Capital.
proposals.after: It stood one hundred ten li north of the Western Capital.
proposals.reason: Changqing/Baideng under Datong Western Capital circuit; Chinese 東京 here is likely a corruption or slip for 西京.

proposals.before: After Emperor Muzong's death Jingzong entered to inherit the Guozhong line, taking the style Yuzhuang.
proposals.after: After Emperor Muzong's death Jingzong entered to inherit the imperial succession, taking the style Yuzhuang.
proposals.reason: 國統 means imperial succession/line of rule, not a proper name 'Guozhong'; 禦莊 is Yuzhuang not Yuzhuan.

decisions.reason: 大同軍節度使 modifies Li Guochang; Keyong separately held the Yunzhong defense post.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 大同軍節度使李國昌子克用為雲中守捉使

decisions.reason: The comma correctly separates the Yongchun reign period from Mochuo's name.

decisions.after: Early in the Guangming era, Guochang was defeated in an attack; with northern Dai undefended, Taizu attacked, took it, and carried off the populace.
decisions.reason: 攻敗國昌 leaves the attacking subject unstated. The passive preserves that ambiguity without inventing anonymous 'forces.'
The transmitted text explicitly says 東京. Replacing it with Western Capital requires a textual witness, not a geographic conjecture.

decisions.after: After Emperor Muzong's death, Jingzong left this residence to inherit the imperial succession, and it became known as the imperial estate.
decisions.reason: 紹國統 means to inherit the imperial succession, while 禦莊 describes the residence as the Imperial Estate rather than supplying Jingzong with a personal style.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 景宗未即位嘗居此……景宗入紹國統，號禦莊
